title: A refused push climbs: Foreman, then Chief of Staff, then the user
summary: Spec v3: a Driver's refused force push goes to the Foreman, which judges and pushes (P10 route rule on Claude Code, no read on Copilot); refused or not tried, the Chief of Staff judges again and pushes, no ask (a failed hard check answers push refused); refused, one user question. No open question.
